Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R

The issue in the present Special Leave Petition is squarely covered against the petitioners in view of the Constitution Bench decision of this Court in the case of Indore Development Authority vs.
Manoharlal & Ors. Etc. reported in 2020 (8) SCC 129.

sentences.text: In the present case, the possession was taken over in the year 1967, which is evident from the fact that even the petitioners applied for release of the land under Section 48 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and even filed a suit for recovery of the possession.
Meaning thereby, even the petitioners also admitted the possession by the State Government.

In that view of the matter and applying the law laid down by this Court in the case of Indore Development Authority (supra), there shall not be any deemed lapse of acquisition under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as sought to be contended on behalf of the petitioners.

sentences.text: We are in complete agreement with the view taken by the High Court.
The Special Leave Petition stands dismissed.
